item.title: Resume
item.description: Work Experience ESnet — Computer Systems Engineer January 2020 - Present Led a team of 4 Computer Systems Engineers managing critical production systems including GitLab, Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Artifact storage, Google Cloud Platform integrations, and Kubernetes environments. Managed team project lifecycle from ideation to implementation, product purchasing and renewals, and employee hiring and onboarding. Built and scaled Kubernetes based container platform for IPv6 native environments. Implemented GitOps based workflow for deployments using ArgoCD.

item.title: About
item.description: Hey there, I’m Luke Baker - software developer, systems administrator, and a Kubernetes enthusiast. I’m passionate about technology, open source, and everything in between. I find joy in fixing things and helping people do more of what they love. When I’m not working, you’ll find me (trying) to keep up with my kids’ growing list of hobbies and activities. My career began at the University of Missouri, working initially as a desktop support technician and later a Linux systems administrator.
